description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP DME, CSL conversion: read a 64 KB calibration partial and report the checksums, the logic patches (MAP, TANK VENT, WOT TH, RF GATE), how far the VE (alpha-N) and warm-up tables are from stock, and the VE table.

bin_path.description: Path to the 64 KB (65,536-byte) MSS54HP calibration partial ("0401 partial BIN") on this machine.

use_sample.description: Use the bundled practice BIN and practice drive instead of files — to show what the tool does before the owner has files.

name: read_bin
title: Read an MSS54HP DME image
